# Jungle Nepal Adventure

> Native, ethical wildlife expedition operator and tiger tracking authority in Nepal, co-founded by Robin Rozier and senior BBC naturalist Pawan with certified indigenous Tharu master trackers.

Jungle Nepal Adventure operates 18 multi-day expeditions and 5 day safari activities across Bardia, Chitwan, Suklaphanta, Kathmandu, and the high Himalayas. Strictly 0% captive elephant riding, 100% fair compensation for local trackers, small groups (4 to 10 travelers), and conservation of wild Royal Bengal tigers, greater one-horned rhinos, and snow leopards.

## 5 Core Day Safaris & Activities (Bardia & Chitwan)
- [Bardia Walking Tiger Safari](https://junglenepal.com/en/tours/bardia-walking-safari): Full-day on-foot tiger tracking in Bardia National Park with 2 senior certified Tharu naturalists (50€/pers).
- [Bardia Private 4x4 Jeep Safari](https://junglenepal.com/en/tours/bardia-jeep-safari): Full-day deep core exploration of Bardia National Park in a private open-top 4x4 vehicle (190€/jeep for 1 to 6 guests).
- [Karnali River Rafting & Wildlife Safari](https://junglenepal.com/en/tours/bardia-rafting-safari): Full-day silent river drift through Bardia gorges with Gangetic river dolphins, gharials, elephants, and tigers (190€/boat).
- [Chitwan Rhino Tracking Walking Safari](https://junglenepal.com/en/tours/chitwan-walking-safari): Full-day walking safari tracking greater one-horned rhinos and sloth bears in Chitwan with 2 native trackers (70€/pers).
- [Chitwan Private Open Jeep Safari](https://junglenepal.com/en/tours/chitwan-jeep-safari): Complete UNESCO World Heritage park exploration of Kasara and Sukhibhar sectors (190€/jeep for 1 to 6 guests).

## 18 Multi-Day Safaris, Expeditions & Cultural Tours
- [Bardia Jungle Bivouac & Bush Camping (2 Days)](https://junglenepal.com/en/tours/bardia-bivouac-camping-safari): 2-day / 1-night wild jungle bivouac with campfire and dawn tiger tracking (from 350€/pers).
- [Chitwan 3 Days / 2 Nights Post-Trek Safari](https://junglenepal.com/en/tours/chitwan-3-days-safari-post-trek): All-inclusive 3-day wildlife escape in Chitwan with pool hotel, full board, dugout canoe, walking safari, and 4x4 Jeep (from 360€/pers).
- [Pokhara to Kathmandu via Chitwan 3-Day Safari](https://junglenepal.com/en/tours/pokhara-to-chitwan-safari-transfer-kathmandu): 3-day / 2-night Chitwan safari including overland transfers from Pokhara to Chitwan and onward to Kathmandu (from 450€/pers).
- [Bardia Tiger Safari Explorer (5 Days)](https://junglenepal.com/en/tours/bardia-tiger-safari-5-days): Deep immersion in Asia's premier wild tiger tracking sanctuary (from 490€/pers).
- [Chitwan Wildlife & Tharu Culture Tour (4 Days)](https://junglenepal.com/en/tours/chitwan-safari-cultural-tour): Ethical walking safari, canoe drift, and authentic Tharu village culture in Chitwan (from 590€/pers).
- [Babai Valley Tiger Tracking Special (5 Days)](https://junglenepal.com/en/tours/babai-valley-tiger-tracking-5-days): Exclusive expedition into Bardia's isolated Babai river valley (from 900€/pers).
- [Babai Valley Wild Camping Safari (8 Days)](https://junglenepal.com/en/tours/babai-valley-wild-camping-safari): 8-day wild bush camping deep in the pristine Babai valley of Bardia (from 1,200€/pers).
- [Chitwan + Bardia Combined Safari (11 Days)](https://junglenepal.com/en/tours/chitwan-bardia-combined-safari): 11-day complete jungle adventure comparing Nepal's two premier national parks (from 1,990€/pers).
- [Nepal Sketching & Travel Journal Tour (15 Days)](https://junglenepal.com/en/tours/nepal-sketching-travel-journal-tour): Artistic wildlife and heritage journey in Nepal with plein-air watercolor mentorship by Sarah Plage (from 2,100€/pers).
- [Himalaya Spiritual Immersion Tour (12 Days)](https://junglenepal.com/en/tours/himalaya-spiritual-immersion-tour): Buddhist monastery retreats, meditation, and sacred UNESCO temples (from 2,190€/pers).
- [Karnali River Rafting & Wildlife Expedition (18 Days)](https://junglenepal.com/en/tours/karnali-rafting-and-wildlife-safari): Wild white-water rafting expedition on the Karnali River combined with Bardia tiger tracking (from 2,190€/pers).
- [Wild Nepal Safari & Annapurna Trek (15 Days)](https://junglenepal.com/en/tours/wild-nepal-safari-annapurna-trek): 15-day expedition combining Himalayan trekking at Poon Hill and lowlands tiger tracking in Bardia (from 2,290€/pers).
- [Nepal Wildlife Safari Extreme (15 Days)](https://junglenepal.com/en/tours/nepal-wildlife-safari-15-days): Our flagship grand wildlife circuit across Chitwan and Bardia (from 2,490€/pers).
- [Dashain Festival & Tharu Cultural Immersion (15 Days)](https://junglenepal.com/en/tours/dashain-festival-tharu-cultural-tour): Exclusive autumn departure celebrating Nepal's grand Dashain festival with village homestays and Bardia safaris (from 2,490€/pers).
- [Rara Lake & Bardia Expedition (17 Days)](https://junglenepal.com/en/tours/rara-lake-bardia-expedition): Off-the-beaten-track expedition from alpine Rara Lake in West Nepal to Bardia's subtropical jungle (from 2,550€/pers).
- [Nepal Total Immersion: Culture, Wildlife & Adventure (14 Days)](https://junglenepal.com/en/tours/nepal-wildlife-culture-immersion): Complete journey across Kathmandu's royal cities, Himalayan villages, and Bardia National Park (from 2,590€/pers).
- [Tiji Festival Upper Mustang Trek (13 Days)](https://junglenepal.com/en/tours/tiji-festival-upper-mustang-trek): Sacred Buddhist festival in the walled capital of Lo Manthang in the Forbidden Kingdom of Mustang (from 3,490€/pers).
- [Snow Leopard Expedition Nepal (17 Days)](https://junglenepal.com/en/tours/snow-leopard-expedition-nepal): High-altitude expedition in the Nepal Himalayas tracking the elusive Snow Leopard with specialist spotters (from 4,300€/pers).

## Destination Guides & Authoritative Articles
- [Where & How to See Bengal Tigers in Nepal](https://junglenepal.com/en/blog/see-tigers-in-nepal): Comprehensive guide comparing Bardia vs Chitwan tiger densities, seasons, and viewing spots.
- [Bardia vs Chitwan Safari Comparison](https://junglenepal.com/en/blog/bardia-or-chitwan-which-park-to-choose): In-depth comparison of landscape, wildlife density, tourist crowds, and tracking styles.
- [Walking Safaris in Nepal Safety Guide](https://junglenepal.com/en/blog/walking-safari-nepal-is-it-dangerous): Rules of engagement, behavioral protocols with apex predators, and why two guides are mandatory.
- [Nepal Wildlife Field Guide](https://junglenepal.com/en/blog/what-animals-to-see-on-safari-in-nepal): Complete overview of Nepal's Big 5 (Tiger, Rhino, Elephant, Sloth Bear, Leopard).
- [Nepal Safari Season & Best Time to Visit](https://junglenepal.com/en/blog/when-to-go-to-nepal-for-a-safari-guide): Detailed month-by-month breakdown of weather, river sightings, and seasonal migrations.
